background: Citigroup is the holding company of the most international of the large US banks, with services, markets, banking, wealth and US personal banking as its main lines, and a multi-year restructuring behind it.
synthesis: Citigroup is rated A- on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at BBB+, one on a positive outlook and two on a stable outlook; the last move was a one-notch downgrade by one of the three on 2 Dec 2015. Capital is on the weak side of US banks, with CET1 of 11.8% and leverage of 5.2% both below the peer median, while liquidity is the strength, LCR of 128% in the top quarter. Leverage has fallen 0.6 points since 31 Mar 2025 and LCR has risen 11 points since 31 Mar 2024, with CET1 broadly flat (figures to 30 Jun 2026). Most of the flagged news, the newest on 1 Oct 2026, is about Citigroup's research calls on other companies rather than its own credit.
